description: 13.06 TERRAIN AND MOVEMENT: a MOBILE model 'can move horizontally through dense terrain features', but SETTING UP OR ENDING A MOVE lets a model end on a surface that is not ground level only with INFANTRY/BEASTS/SWARM/FLY/MONSTER (and 13.06.01: no model ends through a Solid wall). Review fix: TerrainManager.solid_terrain_endpoint_blocker_11e exempted every MOBILE unit, so a MOUNTED or WALKER unit with a rule-granted MOBILE (FENRISIAN FEROCITY, Skilled Riders, UNSTOPPABLE MOMENTUM, STOMPING JUGGERNAUT, the 24.35 gamble) could end on a dense platform's top or inside a wall; now only INFANTRY/BEASTS/SWARM are exempt. Official layout take_and_hold_vs_reconnaissance_1 over the sw11e_s3_active fixture: the player selects Thunderwolf Cavalry (MOUNTED) in the unit list, clicks Normal Move, and in the unit_selected_to_move window clicks Use on FENRISIAN FEROCITY (1 CP: MOBILE this phase). Dragging a cavalry model onto the dense platform generator-11 shows 'Cannot overlap with walls' and the drop is refused; dragging it 9" ACROSS the generator to the open ground past it reads the raw 9.0" (green), is staged at the raw distance, and End This Unit's Move leaves it there.

One Thunderwolf Cavalry model (MOUNTED, M12", 60mm base) on the open battlefield east of the area at (31.5", 43"); its other models and every unit but a far-away Gretchin mob removed from play.

var mc = tree.root.get_node("Main").movement_controller
var r = mc.drag_ruler_visual
var reason = str(mc.illegal_reason_label.text) if mc.illegal_reason_label else "<no label>"
var ruler = (str(r.label_text) if r != null and is_instance_valid(r) else "no ruler")
print("[%s] held over the generator top: ruler '%s' reason '%s'" % ["mobile_cannot_end_on_dense_feature_11e", ruler, reason])
return reason

steps.script:
var mc = tree.root.get_node("Main").movement_controller
var r = mc.drag_ruler_visual
if r == null or not is_instance_valid(r):
	return "no ruler"
var reason = str(mc.illegal_reason_label.text) if mc.illegal_reason_label else "<no label>"
print("[%s] held past the generator: ruler '%s' slot=%s reason '%s'" % ["mobile_cannot_end_on_dense_feature_11e", r.label_text, r.label_slot, reason])
return "%s|%s|%s" % [r.label_text, r.label_slot, reason]

steps.script:
var m = GameState.get_unit("U_THUNDERWOLF_CAVALRY_B")["models"][0]
var p = m["position"]
var here = TerrainManager.get_terrain_at_position(Vector2(float(p.x), float(p.y)))
print("[%s] after the move: (%.2f, %.2f)in on '%s'" % ["mobile_cannot_end_on_dense_feature_11e", float(p.x) / 40.0, float(p.y) / 40.0, str(here.get("id", ""))])
return "%s|%s" % [str(absf(float(p.x) / 40.0 - 22.5) < 0.3 and absf(float(p.y) / 40.0 - 43.0) < 0.3), str(here.get("id", ""))]
